dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)>Whoa there, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! Wait for me!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>You’re about to head through that gate, right? Then I’ll
come along with you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>Você está prestes a ir através desse portão, certo? Então eu vou
Vem com você!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I wonder what lies ahead of us. This is certainly exciting,
isn’t it, <$cdef(27)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Pergunto-me o que nos espera.
não é, <$cdef(27)>?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)>Whoa there, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! Wait for me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)>Calma aí. <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>Espera por mim!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>What do you suppose we’ll find beyond this gate? Let’s go
find out for ourselves!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>O que você acha que vamos encontrar além deste portão? Vamos
Descubram por nós mesmos!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)>Whoa there, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! Wait for me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)>Calma aí. <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>Espera por mim!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>I see you’re able to go through yet another new gate now!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Come on, then—let’s see what’s on the other side!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Vejo que você é capaz de passar por mais um novo portão agora!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Venha, então – vamos ver o que está do outro lado!

dialogues.en: Is it time yet?
dialogues.pt_br: Já está na hora?

dialogues.en: Can I open my eyes now?
dialogues.pt_br: Posso abrir os olhos agora?

dialogues.en: Looook...thaaat...
